veranderings.voor: druk al die rots bo-op baie hard
veranderings.na: druk al die rots daarbo baie hard
veranderings.rede: 'bo-op' is a preposition that wants an object; the adverb 'daarbo' says 'the rock above' plainly and reads more smoothly.

vlae.blok: Vier uitdagings diep onder die grond
vlae.teks: Daar onder wag vier groot uitdagings vir die mynwerkers: ventilasie, hitte, rotsstortings en stof.
vlae.rede: Ventilation is the solution, not the challenge (the challenge is too little fresh air), so the list mixes a remedy with three dangers; fixing it means changing a protected video word and the content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
